purpose: Form NCLAT-6 is used by the Appellate Tribunal to suo motu issue summons for the production of public documents or other documents in the custody of a public officer.
who: Not stated in the Rules text
when: Not stated in the Rules text
steps: The Appellate Tribunal decides to act suo motu.
The Appellate Tribunal issues summons for production of documents.
The summons is issued in Form NCLAT-6.
checklist: Ensure the document is a public document or in the custody of a public officer.
Confirm the summons is issued in Form NCLAT-6.
watch: Not stated in the Rules text
